name: @destaworks/web
//: The operator app's own manifest. It had none until now: web WAS the root application
before Phase 2.9 moved its files under apps/, and the root manifest simply stayed put.
Two costs of that, both real. Size: every web dependency -- Next, React, recharts,
@dnd-kit, xlsx -- sat in the ROOT dependencies, so a production install for the API or
the worker dragged the entire UI tree into a backend container image.
Correctness: two checks in scripts/check-architecture.mjs are gated on `hasOwnManifest`
and are skipped entirely for a unit without one -- `imports <workspace package> but the
manifest does not declare it`, and `imports external <package> undeclared in its
manifest`. The largest app in the repo was opted out of both. See the same note in
apps/admin/package.json, which has had a manifest since it was created.
No scripts here on purpose: the build runs from the repo root (`app:build`), because the
working directory decides what Tailwind v4 scans -- from apps/web it would root here and
